parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query the ID.

parameters.name: AuthMode
parameters.description:
The authentication mode. Valid values:
- **0**: no authentication.
- **1**: Token.
- **2**: account.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and view the ID in the address bar.
